Seasons.Text: The year in Stardew Valley is divided into 4 seasons of 28 days each:

Spring.Name: Spring
Spring.Description: Mild weather with pleasant rain showers.

Summer.Name: Summer
Summer.Description: Warm, sunny days with occasional thunderstorms.

Fall.Name: Fall
Fall.Description: Cool and crisp weather with colorful foliage and light rain.

Winter.Name: Winter
Winter.Description: Cold and snowy conditions where outdoor crops do not grow natively.

TheFarm.Name: The Farm
TheFarm.Description: The farmer's home and property, featuring barns, coops, greenhouse, sheds, and agricultural fields.

PelicanTown_SeedShop.Name: Pierre's General Store
PelicanTown_SeedShop.Description: Local general store selling seeds and everyday supplies, run by Pierre alongside Caroline and Abigail.

PelicanTown_JojaMart.Name: JojaMart
PelicanTown_JojaMart.Description: Corporate competitor supermarket managed by Morris, employing Shane and Sam.

PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Name: The Stardrop Saloon
PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Description: The social hub of Pelican Town, operated by Gus with assistance from Emily. Offers food, drinks, arcade games, and a pool table.

PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Name: Harvey's Clinic
PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Description: The town's medical clinic managed by Dr. Harvey, with Maru working part-time as a nurse.

PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith
PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Description: Operated by Clint, providing tool upgrades and geode processing services.

PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Name: Library & Museum
PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Description: Curated by Gunther, housing public exhibits of donated artifacts, minerals, and lost books.

PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Name: Community Center
PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Description: The historical heart of the valley, initially dilapidated and awaiting restoration through Junimo bundles or Joja conversion.

PelicanTown_HaleyHouse.Name: 2 Willow Lane
PelicanTown_HaleyHouse.Description: The residential home shared by sisters Emily and Haley, featuring Emily's sewing station and Haley's photography darkroom.

PelicanTown_SamHouse.Name: 1 Willow Lane
PelicanTown_SamHouse.Description: The family home of Jodi, Kent, Sam, and Vincent.

PelicanTown_JoshHouse.Name: 1 River Road
PelicanTown_JoshHouse.Description: The riverside home of George, Evelyn, and Alex.

PelicanTown_ManorHouse.Name: Mayor's Manor
PelicanTown_ManorHouse.Description: The official residence of Mayor Lewis, containing town ledgers and community service records.

PelicanTown_Trailer.Name: The Trailer
PelicanTown_Trailer.Description: The riverside dwelling of Pam and Penny.

PelicanTown_Sewer.Name: The Sewers
PelicanTown_Sewer.Description: Subterranean tunnels beneath the town where Krobus sells rare wares, leading toward the Mutant Bug Lair.

PelicanTown_MovieTheater.Name: Movie Theater
PelicanTown_MovieTheater.Description: Modern cinema venue offering seasonal film screenings and specialty concessions for town residents.

PelicanTown_JenkinsHouse.Name: Jenkins Residence
PelicanTown_JenkinsHouse.Description: The upscale manor home of Olivia and Victor, complete with a private wine cellar.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: Vast wilderness south of the farm containing Leah's cottage, Marnie's ranch, the Wizard's Tower, and the Traveling Cart on weekends.

CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Name: Marnie's Ranch
CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Description: Livestock and farm animal supply shop. Home to Marnie, Jas, and Shane.

CindersapForest_LeahHouse.Name: Leah's Cottage
CindersapForest_LeahHouse.Description: A rustic wooden cabin where Leah creates sculptures, woodcarvings, and paintings.

CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Name: Wizard's Tower
CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Description: The secluded stone tower of M. Rasmodius, regarded with quiet curiosity and mystique by villagers.

Mountain.Name: The Mountain
Mountain.Description: Rugged northern region featuring Robin's carpenter shop, Linus's tent, the mine entrance, and the Adventurer's Guild.

Mountain_ScienceHouse.Name: Carpenter's Shop
Mountain_ScienceHouse.Description: Home of Robin, Demetrius, Maru, and Sebastian, providing farm building construction and home upgrade services.

Mountain_LinusTent.Name: Linus' Tent
Mountain_LinusTent.Description: A wilderness campsite where Linus lives in harmony with nature and wildlife.

Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Name: Adventurer's Guild
Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Description: Headquarters for local monster hunters and adventurers, managed by Marlon and Gil.

Mountain_TheMines.Name: The Mines
Mountain_TheMines.Description: Deep underground shafts rich in ores, gems, and dangerous creatures, frequented by brave villagers.

Mountain_Spa.Name: The Spa
Mountain_Spa.Description: Public bathhouse situated near the railroad, utilizing geothermal waters to quickly replenish energy and health.

Beach.Name: The Beach
Beach.Description: Coastal ocean shore south of Pelican Town, home to Willy's fish shop and Elliott's beach cabin.

Beach_FishShop.Name: Willy's Fish Shop
Beach_FishShop.Description: Coastal shop selling fishing tackle, bait, and rods, offering boat transport to Ginger Island once repaired.

Beach_ElliottHouse.Name: Elliott's Cabin
Beach_ElliottHouse.Description: A cozy beachfront cabin where Elliott writes his novels beside the ocean tide.

Desert_Oasis.Name: The Oasis
Desert_Oasis.Description: A colorful boutique in Calico Desert operated by Sandy, selling exclusive seeds and goods accessible after the bus is repaired.

GingerIsland.Name: Ginger Island
GingerIsland.Description: Tropical island destination featuring an island farm, beach resort, and active volcano dungeon.

CindersapForest_BlueMoonVineyard.Name: Blue Moon Vineyard
CindersapForest_BlueMoonVineyard.Description: Winery estate situated in southern Cindersap Forest, maintained and inhabited by Sophia.

CindersapForest_FairhavenFarm.Name: Fairhaven Farm
CindersapForest_FairhavenFarm.Description: A struggling traditional farmstead in Cindersap Forest tended by Andy.

CindersapForest_AuroraVineyard.Name: Aurora Vineyard
CindersapForest_AuroraVineyard.Description: An overgrown vineyard property in western forest territory, later serving as home to Apples the Junimo.

CindersapForest_EnchantedGrove.Name: Enchanted Grove
CindersapForest_EnchantedGrove.Description: Mystical teleportation hub hidden deep in the forest, linking ancient obelisks across the valley.

PelicanTown_GrampletonBridge.Name: Shearwater Bridge
PelicanTown_GrampletonBridge.Description: The expansive bridge spanning eastward toward the neighboring city of Grampleton.

Mountain_Highlands.Name: The Highlands
Mountain_Highlands.Description: Rugged alpine heights north of town where Lance is stationed, marked by tough terrain and monster outposts.

Desert_Badlands.Name: Crimson Badlands
Desert_Badlands.Description: Perilous wasteland beyond the Calico Desert, teeming with ferocious creatures and ancient relics.

GingerIsland_FableReef.Name: Fable Reef
GingerIsland_FableReef.Description: Secluded coral reef expanse south of Ginger Island frequented by Lance for research expeditions.

Festivals.Text: Pelican Town hosts several seasonal community festivals throughout the year:

spring13.Name: Egg Festival
spring13.Description: Spring 13: Annual gathering in the town square featuring the traditional egg hunt competition.

spring24.Name: Flower Dance
spring24.Description: Spring 24: Traditional springtime waltz held in the forest where villagers dance with their chosen partners.

summer11.Name: The Luau
summer11.Description: Summer 11: Beach potluck gathering where villagers contribute ingredients to a shared communal soup.

summer28.Name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
summer28.Description: Summer 28: Serene nighttime beach celebration watching the migration of luminous moonlight jellies.

fall16.Name: Stardew Valley Fair
fall16.Description: Fall 16: Vibrant carnival festival featuring midway minigames, star token prizes, and the grange display contest.

fall27.Name: Spirit's Eve
fall27.Description: Fall 27: Halloween celebration in the town square featuring a haunted maze and festive autumn treats.

winter8.Name: Festival of Ice
winter8.Description: Winter 8: Northern lakeside gathering with ice sculptures, igloos, and an ice fishing competition.

winter25.Name: Feast of the Winter Star
winter25.Description: Winter 25: Cozy year-end banquet focused on community gift exchanges and celebrating the Winter Star.
